gates.G2_no_cross_host: No row's outcome may be read as evidence about any host other than its own. THREE research hosts appear here — icsid.worldbank.org, www.italaw.com, uncitral.un.org — and they are three separate evidentiary universes. gates.G3_pdf_find_is_void_by_construction: NEW GATE, DERIVED FROM THE CODE BEFORE THE RESULT EXISTS, and it is the reason urls[3] carries an EMPTY find. scripts/fetch_relay.py:124-125 returns an empty excerpt for any content-type containing neither 'html' nor 'text', and :181-182 computes find_matched as bool(find) and bool(excerpt_of(...)). Therefore ON A PDF A FIND CAN NEVER MATCH, whatever the document contains. Had a find string been placed on urls[3], its find_matched:false would have been an artifact of the content-type and would have carried ZERO information about the document — it would have been VOID BY CONSTRUCTION, not a null, and must never be banked as one. The find is left empty so that no seat can later mistake a structural false for a searched-for absence. WHAT urls[3] ASKS IS EXISTENCE ONLY: outcome, status, content_type, bytes, sha256. ONE DISCRIMINATION IS AVAILABLE AND IS PRE-REGISTERED: if content_type comes back as text/html with a 200, we did NOT receive the PDF — we received a page about it, and the byte length is that page's, not the document's.
gates.G4_no_durations: No duration may be read off fetched_at. Rows are ordered, not timed.

NONE may be restated as a fact about a case, an award, a proceeding, a treaty, a person, or a document's existence. In particular: nothing in this batch may found a claim that A/81/17 has or has not been issued, that any Einarsson document was or was not filed, that any named person did or did not act in any matter, or that the italaw document does or does not exist or does or does not mention anyone.
